compact_relative_cup.source_base: T3 minus open ball (one spherical source boundary)
compact_relative_cup.S3_puncture_comparison: S3 minus balls: H1 bulk zero and strict boundary collar relative H1 triple cup vanishes (parallel cb1a667). Punctured T3 has three bulk H1 classes and triple relative cup =1.
compact_relative_cup.limitation: Nonzero bulk cohomology ALLOWS, but does not produce, E8 gauge-invariant physical Yukawa amplitudes; a T3 gauge 3-cycle generally carries additional adjoint H1 modes, and no G2 metric or sourced 7D geometry is constructed.

hollow_Yukawa_hierarchy.proof: Takagi Y=U diag(s1,s2,s3) U^T. Diagonal zeros imply s1 |U_i1|^2 <= sum_{j>1} s_j |U_ij|^2 by triangle inequality, for each row i. Sum over rows; column normalization gives s1<=s2+s3.
hollow_Yukawa_hierarchy.correction_proof: If Y_phys=Y_hollow+Delta and delta=||Delta||_2, singular-value Lipschitz inequality yields s1_phys <= s2_phys+s3_phys+3delta.
hollow_Yukawa_hierarchy.claim_limit: Assumes single complex-symmetric hollow Yukawa, canonical kinetic metrics, and no Higgs-dependent vectorlike mixing. In a realistic model the masses must be compared at a common renormalization scale; this illustrative 1:0.01:0.00001 example is NOT used as measured input.

E8_singlet_D_cone.Fflat_warning: A nonzero cubic W=kappa*S13*S34*S14_conj has nonzero F-terms on the triangle ray if all three VEVs are nonzero. Kappa, other operators, and their actual relative-cup overlap are NOT determined here.
E8_singlet_D_cone.physical_limit: One-spurion gauge invariance and D-flatness are necessary but NOT sufficient to realize fermion masses: the strict bulk relative-cup on the punctured S3 remains zero, full F-flatness/source action, gauge anomalies and realistic unbroken SM are open. Imported chiral singlet spectrum is from cb1a667.
